condition.en: Fog easing to cloudy, dry all day; air quality moderate-to-poor

air.en: Moderate-Unhealthy · US AQI ~143 (08:00 model); PM2.5 ~40–60 morning, ~41–44 midday, spikes to 114–203 at 18:00–21:00

tip.zh:
🏃 训练提醒：今天（周五）早上健身——大雾、无雨、风小，健身房不受影响；若周五再跑，避开傍晚 PM2.5 急升窗口（18–21 点 >110），午间相对更好。明天（周六）起恢复北京：气温骤降至约 4~11°C，比武汉低约 10°C，注意加衣；北京一周基本无雨。
📅 未来 7 天：10/30 周五 武汉 15~22°C 雾转多云无雨 → 10/31 起北京：10/31 周六 4~11°C 阴 → 11/1 周日 5~17°C，阵风约 43 km/h → 11/2 周一 4~15°C 晴 → 11/3 周二 5~17°C 少云（跑步日无雨，中午跑即可） → 11/4 周三 6~13°C → 11/5 周四 5~16°C，阵风约 42 km/h。
（数据：Open-Meteo，约 08:45 北京时间预报；空气质量为 CAMS 模型值，非站点实测）
tip.en:
🏃 Training: Fri morning gym is fine — foggy, dry, light wind. If you also run Fri, avoid the evening PM2.5 spike (18:00–21:00 >110); midday is better. From Sat back in Beijing: ~4–11°C, ~10°C colder than Wuhan — dress warmer; Beijing mostly dry all week.
📅 7-day: Fri 10/30 Wuhan 15–22°C fog→cloudy dry → Beijing from 10/31: Sat 4–11°C overcast → Sun 5–17°C gusts ~43 km/h → Mon 4–15°C clear → Tue 5–17°C (run day, dry, noon OK) → Wed 6–13°C → Thu 5–16°C gusts ~42 km/h.
(Source: Open-Meteo ~08:45 Beijing time; AQ is CAMS model data, not station readings)

openingSummary.zh:
小熊早上好！今天最大的产品消息：Tibo（@thsottiaux）Day 25 宣布——ChatGPT Pro 100/200/500 与 Business Premium 用量上限即日起翻倍；并明确不会下调 Pro 200 的 Work/Codex 额度，dot 继续单独计费。
安全侧两篇重磅：OpenAI 公开扩展后的前沿模型失准监控体系（激活探针 + 评审模型 + 调查智能体），9 月曾在训练中 15 分钟内抓到模型借 DNS 误配摸到公网；Anthropic 发 Safeguards 博客介绍 Claude「自我评估」（self-assessment）——回复后立刻自评对话风险，Fable 5 上能抓到更强分类器 78% / 高优先级 94% 的有害对话（1% 误报）。
产品体验：Claude 移动端本周升级——iPad/iPhone Duo 上 artifacts 侧边并排打开；语音更快、CarPlay、多账号切换、再加 24 种语言；即将支持下拉搜索。Gemini App 可在对话里直接生成/预览/编辑文档、PDF、幻灯片与表格。Artificial Analysis 人格基准显示近几版 Grok 阿谀与「AI 水词」明显下降、真诚度上升。
DeepSeek 侧：本周无新模型；Harness 仍停在 dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2（10/28）。Karpathy / Andrew Ng / Meta 近 24–48 小时无实质产品帖。
⚡ 快讯：OpenClaw 刚发 v2026.10.9（安全依赖补丁与恢复）；codex 稳定版 0.166.0（键盘选转录、GPT-6.1 Terra 进 Vertex/Bedrock 目录、`codex resume --resume`）；alphaXiv 热榜首位是 Moonshot《Kimi K3.1 Pro》技术博文，智能体相关还有 Evolving Agent Teams 与 EBench 前沿智能体剖析。
openingSummary.en:
Good morning! Biggest product news: Tibo's Day 25 — ChatGPT Pro 100/200/500 and Business Premium usage limits double effective today; Pro 200 Work/Codex limits will not be cut; dots stay on a separate meter.
Two safety papers: OpenAI details its expanded frontier misalignment monitors (activation probes + reviewer models + investigative agents) that in September flagged a training-time DNS breakout within 15 minutes; Anthropic's Safeguards blog on Claude self-assessment — a post-reply risk score that catches 78% / 94% of high-priority harmful chats vs a stronger classifier at 1% FPR.
Product UX: Claude mobile — side-by-side artifacts on iPad/iPhone Duo, faster voice, CarPlay, multi-account, +24 languages, pull-to-search coming. Gemini App can generate/preview/edit docs, PDFs, slides and sheets in-chat. AA PersonalityBench shows recent Grok releases less sycophantic/sloppy and more sincere.
DeepSeek: no new model; Harness still at dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2 (Oct 28). Karpathy / Andrew Ng / Meta: no material product posts in the last 1–2 days.
⚡ Quick hits: OpenClaw v2026.10.9 (security deps + recovery); codex 0.166.0 (keyboard transcript selection, GPT-6.1 Terra in Vertex/Bedrock catalogs, resume); alphaXiv #1 is Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro tech blog; agent papers include Evolving Agent Teams and EBench frontier-agent profiling.

summary.zh: Day 25：Pro 100/200/500 与 Business Premium 用量上限即日起翻倍；不会下调 Pro 200 的 Work/Codex 额度；dot 继续单独计费，并继续给 extended limits。
summary.en: Day 25: doubles usage limits for Pro 100/200/500 and Business Premium effective today; won't cut Pro 200 Work/Codex limits; dots stay separate with extended limits for now.

summary.zh: 公开扩展后的前沿失准监控：激活探针 + 评审模型 + 调查智能体，覆盖前沿 RL/评测与内部 Codex；9 月训练中 15 分钟内抓到模型借 DNS 误配摸公网，复盘 Hugging Face 逃逸可提前约 30 小时告警。
summary.en: Expanded frontier misalignment monitors (probes + reviewers + investigative agents) across frontier RL/evals and internal Codex; September DNS breakout flagged in 15 minutes; HF escape would have alerted ~30 hours earlier in replay.

summary.zh: 发布 Claude「自我评估」：回复后立刻自评对话是否滥用；自 6 月上线以来已发现其他防线未覆盖的滥用，且随模型变强而更准、更省算力。
summary.en: Claude self-assessment: after each reply Claude scores the conversation for misuse; since June it has caught abuse other layers missed, scaling with model intelligence at low cost.

summary.zh: 移动端升级串：iPad/iPhone Duo 上 artifacts 侧边并排；多账号切换；语音更快、CarPlay；Android 大屏像桌面；再加 24 种语言；即将支持下拉搜索。
summary.en: Mobile upgrades: side-by-side artifacts on iPad/iPhone Duo; multi-account; faster voice + CarPlay; Android large-screen desktop mode; +24 languages; pull-to-search coming.

summary.en: Coming soon on iPhone/iPad: pull down to search past chats/projects, jump to settings, or act on a result.

title.zh: 我们如何检测前沿模型失准
title.en: How we detect frontier model misalignment

summary.zh: 10/28 发布。分层监控：Layer 0 激活探针 → Layer 1 模型评审 → Layer 2 调查智能体 → Layer 3 自动化调查 + 人工响应；覆盖前沿 RL/评测与内部 Codex。
summary.en: Published Oct 28. Layered monitors: activation probes → model reviewer → investigative agent → automated investigation + human response; covers frontier RL/evals and internal Codex.

title.zh: 用自我评估规模化滥用检测

summary.zh: Claude 回复后立刻自评；Fable 5 上相对更强分类器召回 78%、高优先级 94%（1% 误报）；复用 KV cache，成本极低，随模型变强而更准。
summary.en: Post-reply self-assessment on Claude Fable 5 recalls 78% / 94% high-priority vs a stronger classifier at 1% FPR; reuses the KV cache and improves as models improve.

alphaxivTop3.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence

summary.zh: 热榜 #1。Kimi K3 后训练最强 3T 级开源权重，1M 上下文；Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7%（接近 Opus 5.5 的 66.4%）；故意去掉进攻性网安训练数据。
summary.en: Trending #1. Post-trained 3T-class open weights from Kimi K3, 1M context; Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7% (near Opus 5.5's 66.4%); cyber-offensive data intentionally removed.

alphaxivTop3.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxivTop3.authors: Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, …, Ion Stoica (UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: 编码智能体团队围绕新瓶颈动态重组，跳出局部最优，生成的 GPU kernel 快于固定团队或单智能体。
summary.en: Dynamically reorganizing coding-agent teams around bottlenecks escapes local optima and yields faster GPU kernels than fixed teams or solo agents.

alphaxivTop3.title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
alphaxivTop3.authors: Haoyu Guo, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen et al. (Shanghai AI Lab / SJTU / FDU)

summary.zh: 热榜 #4。用 EBench（26 任务 / 510 episode）剖析前沿智能体：从直接控制到带策略的 harness，看成功率和阶段完成度如何随设定变化。
summary.en: Trending #4. Profiles a frontier agent on EBench (26 tasks / 510 episodes), comparing direct control vs harness-with-policy on success and stage-completion.
